title: dappchat
tagline: Dappchat is a web3 AI assistant for interacting with Gnosis dapps. Interact with Lexi to summarize deployed contracts, read on chain data, send crypto, and interact with the decentralized web.
description: Dappchat aims to make web3 accessible for all. Using our AI chatbot, Lexicon "Lexi", we simplify complex web3 interactions, bridging the gap between traditional finance and blockchain. We target users seeking responsible, user-friendly interfaces, as well as novices and experienced users alike. Our solution caters to the rapidly growing DeFi ecosystem, offering intuitive and secure transactions.
how_its_made: Love, caffeine and good vibes. This project uses React/NextJS along with an openAI starter-kit and language mode. Wagmi & rainbow-kit for wallet connection and interactions. We then used Quicknode as an RPC endpoint for querying and sending transactions to gnosis chain. Authentication and single sign on using sismo. Finally the project is version controlled on GitHub and deployed on vercel.
